storybook.description: Where the built Storybook is and which stories to check.

dir.description: Directory of a built static Storybook (the output of `storybook build`). It must contain `index.json` or `stories.json`.

include.description: Patterns (`*` wildcard, case-insensitive) matched against story id, title and `title/name`. Empty means every story.

exclude.description: Same patterns; a match removes the story.

skipTags.description: Stories carrying any of these tags are skipped. Tag a story `no-visual` to opt it out.

pages.description: Page URLs to screenshot besides, or instead of, stories.

urls.description: Paths (`/pricing`) or full URLs. Each is captured in every profile.

baseUrl.description: Base for relative `urls` when no server command is set.

server.description: A server the workflow starts for the pages.

command.description: Shell command that serves the site, run in the working directory. Empty means none. The capture job needs the project installed: set `capture-install: true`.

url.description: URL polled until the server answers. Also the base URL for relative `urls` when a command is set.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the server before failing.

browsers.description: Engines to run: `chromium`, `firefox`, `webkit`. One matrix leg each.

viewports.description: Named viewports. Merged with the defaults by name; `null` removes a default. Each is `{ "device": "iPhone 13" }` (a Playwright device: size, user agent, touch) or `{ "width", "height" }`.

device.description: A Playwright device name such as `iPhone 13` or `iPad (gen 7)`. Brings the size, user agent, touch and mobile flags.

width.description: CSS pixel width (with `height`, instead of `device`; overrides the device).

deviceScaleFactor.description: Pixel density for this viewport. Default: `capture.deviceScaleFactor`.

isMobile.description: Mobile viewport behaviour. Ignored on Firefox, which does not support it.

browsers.description: Engines this viewport is captured in. Omit for all. Use it to keep Firefox and WebKit to a smaller set.

variants.description: Named reading conditions, merged with the defaults by name; `null` removes one. A profile is every viewport x variant (a variant may limit itself with `viewports`).

forcedColors.description: `active` emulates forced-colors (Windows high contrast); `none` is off.

zoom.description: Browser zoom factor. 2 is 200%: half the CSS viewport at twice the pixel density.

textScale.description: Root `font-size` as a multiple (1.5 is 150% text). Finds fixed-pixel text.

globals.description: Storybook globals sent as `&globals=key:value;...`, for example `{ "theme": "dark" }`.

css.description: CSS injected for this variant only.

viewports.description: Names of the viewports this variant applies to. Omit for all.

browsers.description: Engines this variant is captured in. Omit for all.

capture.description: How a page is rendered and photographed.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scroll height rather than only the viewport.

maxHeight.description: Cap on the captured height in CSS pixels, so an endless page cannot make an endless image.

deviceScaleFactor.description: Pixel density. 1 keeps images small; a viewport can override it with its own `deviceScaleFactor`.

fixedTime.description: ISO time the page clock is fixed to. Empty leaves the real clock.

disableAnimations.description: Disable CSS animations and transitions and hide the caret.

reducedMotion.description: `prefers-reduced-motion` for every profile (`reduce` or `no-preference`). A variant can override it.

settleMs.description: Pause after the page is ready, before the first frame.

waitForFonts.description: Before the first frame, wait until no font is loading for two frames in a row. `document.fonts.ready` alone can resolve before layout has asked for a font.

loadLazyImages.description: Load `loading="lazy"` images and iframes before the frame and wait until they are decoded. A browser that does not scroll never fetches the ones below the fold; Firefox does not fetch them for a full-page capture.

timeoutMs.description: Per-step timeout: navigation, story render, selector wait, images and fonts settling.

stabilityTries.description: Take frames until two in a row are identical, up to this many. 1 turns the check off.

retries.description: Extra attempts for a mismatching or failing shot. A shot that passes on a retry is reported as flaky, not hidden.

concurrency.description: Pages rendered in parallel within one capture job.

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector that must exist before the frame is taken (for example a skeleton gone).

hideSelectors.description: Selectors hidden with `visibility: hidden` (ads, timestamps, carousels).

css.description: CSS injected into every page before the frame.

compare.description: How a screenshot is compared with its baseline.

maxDiffPixels.description: A shot fails when differing pixels exceed `max(maxDiffPixels, maxDiffPixelRatio x pixels)`.

maxDiffPixelRatio.description: Fraction of pixels allowed to differ. A change of image size always fails.

match.description: Pattern matched against story id, title and `title/name`.

maxDiffPixels.description: Allowed differing pixels for matching stories.

maxDiffPixelRatio.description: Allowed fraction of differing pixels for matching stories.

shards.description: Capture jobs per browser: a number, or `auto` to size from `shotsPerShard`.

shotsPerShard.description: Target screenshots per capture job when `shards` is `auto`.

globalPatterns.description: Any changed file matching one of these selects every story (stylesheets, tokens, Storybook config, lockfiles).

siblingDirectory.description: A changed file in the same directory as a story file selects that story. No module graph is built; this is a heuristic.

paths.description: Directories or files to scan for CSS (`.css`, and `<style>` in `.html`). Empty means the staged Storybook.

browserslist.description: Queries that replace the project's own browserslist config. Empty means use `.browserslistrc` / `package.json`.

fail.description: `unsupported` fails when a target lacks a feature that can break the page. `partial` also fails on partial support. `any` also fails on progressive enhancements (`text-wrap: balance`, `scrollbar-width`, view transitions, ...), which are otherwise only reported. `never` only reports.

ignoreFeatures.description: caniuse feature ids to skip, for example `css-has`.

ignoreFiles.description: Patterns (`*` wildcard) of files to skip. Storybook's own UI assets are skipped by default.
